1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.StarOpenEmbedding
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronStarInverseDisks
3 
4 /-! The assembled cofacial-source development is globally injective
5 and identifies the retained surface with an open subset of the plane.
6 This version uses the broader small-polyhedron route results. Where
7 nonoverlap is needed, it is stated explicitly as separation of the charts. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set Filter Topology
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16 
17 include size small_faces
18 
19 /-- No two retained surface points are identified anywhere in the development. -/
20 theorem small_develop_injective {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
21     (separated : charts.KitesSeparated)
22     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
23     Function.Injective (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) := by
24   intro b c same
25   change charts.develop b.val = charts.develop c.val at same
26   obtain ⟨radius, positive, inverse, _, _, left_inverse⟩ :=
27     small_every_retained_point_has_inverse_disk size small_faces charts separated cofacial b
28   have b_in : charts.develop b.val ∈ Metric.ball (charts.develop b.val) radius := Metric.mem_ball_self positive
29   have c_in : charts.develop c.val ∈ Metric.ball (charts.develop b.val) radius := by rw [← same]; exact b_in
30   calc
31     b = inverse ⟨charts.develop b.val, b_in⟩ := (left_inverse b b_in).symm
32     _ = inverse ⟨charts.develop c.val, c_in⟩ := congrArg inverse (Subtype.ext same)
33     _ = c := left_inverse c c_in
34 
35 /-- Open retained surface regions develop to open planar regions. -/
36 theorem small_develop_isOpenMap {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
37     (separated : charts.KitesSeparated)
38     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
39     IsOpenMap (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) := by
40   intro S openS
41   apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
42   rintro y ⟨b, b_in, rfl⟩
43   obtain ⟨radius, positive, inverse, _, right_inverse, left_inverse⟩ :=
44     small_every_retained_point_has_inverse_disk size small_faces charts separated cofacial b
45   let region : Set Plane := Subtype.val '' (inverse ⁻¹' S)
46   have open_region : IsOpen region := Metric.isOpen_ball.isOpenMap_subtype_val _
47     (openS.preimage inverse.continuous)
48   have center_in : charts.develop b.val ∈ region := by
49     refine ⟨⟨charts.develop b.val, Metric.mem_ball_self positive⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
50     change inverse ⟨charts.develop b.val, Metric.mem_ball_self positive⟩ ∈ S
51     rw [left_inverse]
52     exact b_in
53   have covered : region ⊆ (fun c : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop c.val) '' S := by
54     rintro x ⟨z, member, rfl⟩
55     exact ⟨inverse z, member, right_inverse z⟩
56   exact mem_of_superset (open_region.mem_nhds center_in) covered
57 
58 /-- The constructed development is an open embedding of the entire retained surface. -/
59 theorem small_develop_isOpenEmbedding {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
60     (separated : charts.KitesSeparated)
61     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
62     Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) :=
63   .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (small_develop_continuous size small_faces charts cofacial)
64     (small_develop_injective size small_faces charts separated cofacial)
65     (small_develop_isOpenMap size small_faces charts separated cofacial)
66 
67 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
